cohort: Pregnant women admitted with COVID-19 between April 15, 2021 and May 31, 2021
finding: The study found an increased incidence of caesarean sections, preterm deliveries, intrauterine deaths, and maternal ICU admissions and mortality in COVID-19 positive pregnant women.
mod_finding: The study found a relatively higher rate of lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) in COVID-19 positive pregnant women.
